dogecoin.text: Don't confuse buying Dogecoin and being an investor. It's gambling, not investing. I hope everyone makes a ton of money, but the ship will sink eventually, so don't go down with it!

Comparing crypto like $LUNA and $DOGE to the likes of $BTC and $ETH is like comparing the Zimbabwe dollar to the US Dollar.

Are they similar by nature? Sure.

But one being completely useless doesn't mean the entire ecosystem is.
